source_refs.note: Stress: a main subheading of 5.3 Stress, strain and Young's modulus, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 96-96.

blocks.text: Kisi object ki shakal, volume ya lambai badalne ke liye per unit area (har ek square metre par) jo force lagai jaye use stress kehte hain. Formula:

Stress (σ) ka SI unit newton per square metre (N m⁻²) hai, jise pascal (Pa) kehte hain. Stress se lambai, volume ya shakal badal sakti hai. Jo stress lambai badle use tensile stress, jo volume badle use volume stress, aur jo shakal badle use shear stress kehte hain.
